Senses.Explanation: To outshine all before and after praises a saying, exchange, house style, or final act as without predecessor or successor. Jiangshan and Fojian apply it to proposed case-turns, Yunju to the Buddha’s exchange, Yuanwu to Caodong house style, and Shiwū to his own funeral pyre.
